headline: Gold surges above $4,100 as expectations for a US-Iran deal reduce inflation, Fed tightening risk
summary: Gold rebounded above $4,100 after comments suggested a US-Iran agreement could come soon and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, pushing oil lower and weighing on the dollar.
why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset and tends to respond to changes in real yields, the dollar and inflation expectations.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Gold rebounded above $4,100 as easing tensions and lower inflation concerns supported the metal.
